name: @schoolos/catalog
description: SchoolOS reviewed framework catalog (CCSS, NGSS, C3, CASEL, ELOF, TEKS, Michigan) with licensing decisions, PlayTrek-derived seed content, and a district-local catalog mirror with pinned releases, approvals, overlays, upgrade diffs and coverage reports. Its `./durable-object-storage` entry point is the mirror's Durable Object SQLite storage. A library, not a deployable Worker.
